rows.stem: Three friends A, B and C got their photograph clicked. Find the probability that B is standing at the central position, given that A is standing at the left corner.

rows.subtopic: Area Bounded by a Curve and a Line
rows.stem: If the area of the region bounded by the line \(y = mx\) and the curve \(x^2 = y\) is \(\dfrac{32}{3}\) sq. units, then find the positive value of m, using integration.

If \(\vec{a} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{c} = \hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - \hat{k}\) and the projection of vector \(\vec{c} + \lambda \vec{b}\) on vector \(\vec{a}\) is \(2\sqrt{6}\), then find the value of \(\lambda\).
